name: The Westin Josun Seoul
positioning: A downtown Seoul hotel established in 1914, connected to the Hwangudan shrine and near Myeongdong and City Hall, with a glass-roofed pool and Korean scrub rituals at its City Athletic Club
best_for: Travelers who want a historic hotel in central Seoul near palaces and Myeongdong
Wellness-minded guests who want an indoor pool and a traditional Korean scrub

facts.text: The hotel has a history of hosting major South Korean political, economic and cultural events.
The hotel is in downtown Seoul near City Hall, Myeongdong and Gwanghwamun.
The hotel is near Gyeongbokgung Palace, Seoul's largest palace.
The hotel is near Bukchon Hanok Village.
One room type has a view of Hwangudan.
Rooms have Nespresso machines and anti-allergy carpets.
The hotel's top suite has a grand parlor and a formal dining room.
The City Athletic Club includes a sauna, V-Spa and a fitness center.
Room packages include curated tours such as a DMZ Tour, a Seoul City Tour and a Myeongdong NANTA Tour.
The Lounge & Bar serves afternoon tea sets, classic cocktails and premium single-malt whiskies.

highlights.text: The hotel is connected to Hwangudan, a shrine complex with a coronation site and Hwanggungu.
The City Athletic Club has a 25-meter indoor pool lit by natural sunlight from a glass ceiling.
On-gi is a Korean body scrub program at the City Athletic Club that blends traditional bathing rituals with modern wellness.
The Renewal Suite blends Korean tradition with Western comfort.

considerations.text: On weekends, public holidays, summer peak and year-end, City Athletic Club access is limited to once per day per guest.
WhataHotel notes the busy Myeongdong area may be crowded during peak tourist seasons.
